verdict.rationale: Navan's official MCP server lets an AI assistant answer questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons, explaining why a transaction was flagged and which policy applies (navan-docs-22, navan-docs-6). Its first-party Ava assistant compares spend to company policy (navan-docs-19, navan-docs-31). This covers explaining declines and policy Q&A, which can serve as a pre-spend "can I expense this?" check. However, the evidence frames these tools mainly around querying and analyzing spend that has already happened, and shows no proactive enforcement. Missing for 10: AI-driven chasing of missing receipts, an explicit pre-spend "can I expense this?" eligibility check, assistant-initiated policy enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
